verification.validation: Basic release gate (pnpm run gates): policy, version and executor manifest checks, Go vet/build and units, Python units, Node typecheck/units/build, frontend typecheck/units/build including the new Control Panel tests, packed consumer import, pack and content scans; both npm tarballs scanned for internal content and secrets before publication. No full gate, QEMU, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance.
